0007: Sit on a bench under a high pulley with a single handle attached.
Reach up and hold the handle in one hand, arm straight.
Pull the handle down to the side of your shoulder, driving your elbow toward your ribs.
Let it rise slowly until your arm is straight.
0045: Lie on the bench with your feet planted. Use a light load with a spotter and set the safety stops before you lift.
Take a closed overhand grip, a little wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar toward the top of your chest near the base of your neck, moving slowly and keeping your elbows out.
Pause above the body, keeping control of the bar throughout.
Press back up smoothly and return the bar to the rack when you finish.
Use only the range you can control comfortably.
0067: Practise with a weightlifting coach. Start with a light bar on the floor and stand so you can reach its centre.
Bend at the hips and knees and grasp the middle of the bar with one hand.
Extend through the legs and hips and pull the bar up close to your body.
Move under the bar and steady it overhead with the working arm extended.
Stand tall once you have control. Lower the bar as your coach demonstrates, then reset before changing arms.
0139: Set a bar at about waist height and lie underneath it.
Grip it with your palms facing you and your hands close together.
Straighten your body from head to heels, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up to the bar, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
0172: Set an incline bench in front of a high pulley with a straight bar, so the cable comes from behind your head.
Sit back against the bench and grip the bar overhead with straight arms, hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Pull the bar down in front of your face to your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back.
Squeeze your back at the bottom.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight overhead again.
0216: Set the cable at elbow height and sit on the floor side-on to it, legs straight.
Hold the handle in the hand nearer the machine, elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Rotate your forearm in across your stomach, keeping the elbow in place.
Pause, then let the forearm rotate back out slowly.
Finish the reps, then turn around and switch arms.
0221: Sit on the dome of a bosu ball with your back to a low pulley, knees bent and feet flat.
Hold the cable handle in one hand at your side and lean back slightly.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips while bending sideways.
Return slowly, finish the reps, then switch sides.
0225: Set both pulleys high with a handle on each and stand in the middle.
Take the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left, so the cables cross in front of you.
Start with your arms crossed in front of your chest, elbows slightly bent.
Sweep your arms out and back to the sides at shoulder height, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly to the crossed position.
0299: Stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Draw your elbows upward and outward in a comfortable range, keeping the weights near your body.
Keep the upper arms steady and rotate the shoulders so your forearms come upright.
Press the dumbbells overhead with control. Lower to shoulder height and reverse the rotation.
Lower the dumbbells to the starting position before repeating.
0365: Kneel behind a flat bench and rest your forearms on it, hands just past the edge.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other, thumbs up.
Keep your forearms on the bench and tilt the dumbbells up by bending at the wrists.
Pause, then let them tilt down as far as is comfortable.
0492: Have a coach set a stable platform for your feet and a low, secure pad for each hand, about shoulder-width apart.
Adopt a push-up position with your feet supported and your hands on the floor between the pads.
Keep your trunk and legs aligned as you push off with your hands.
Land with one hand on each pad and absorb the contact with slightly bent elbows.
Return both hands to the floor together, absorbing the landing through your arms. Keep your feet supported throughout.
Reset between repetitions and stop the set if you lose control of the landing.
0500: Get into a push-up position with your hands wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest until it is just above the floor.
Stay low and shift your body toward one hand.
Slide across to the other hand without pushing up.
Keep your body straight and your core tight the whole time.
0526: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, a kettlebell hanging in each hand.
Hinge slightly at the hips with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and clean one kettlebell to the rack position at your shoulder, keeping it close to your body.
Lower it back to the hang as you clean the other one.
Keep alternating sides in a steady rhythm.
0537: Stand over a light kettlebell and take its handle with one hand.
Hinge at the hips with slightly bent knees and bring the kettlebell between your legs.
Extend your hips to bring the kettlebell into the rack position at your shoulder, with the bell close to your body.
Dip slightly at the knees, then drive the kettlebell overhead. Stabilize it with your arm extended.
Lower it to the shoulder, then back between the legs under control. Reset before the next repetition.
0572: Set the assistance, then kneel on the pad.
Grip the close handles with your palms facing you, arms straight.
Pull yourself up, driving your elbows down toward your sides.
Bring your chin above the handles.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
0578: Stand on the platform between the handles with your feet hip-width apart.
Push your hips back, bend your knees and grip the handles at your sides with a flat back.
Drive through your feet and stand up tall, squeezing your glutes.
Lower the handles by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Keep your chest up and your back flat throughout.
0609: Stand facing a rope hung from a high anchor, feet close to its base.
Grip the rope with both hands, one above the other.
Walk your hands down the rope one at a time, leaning back as your knees bend.
Go as low as you can control.
Climb back up hand over hand to standing.
0709: Rest your forearms on the pads of a knee raise station, back against the pad, legs hanging.
Raise your bent knees up and toward one side, turning your hips.
0720: Hang from a bar with a wide overhand grip and your arms straight.
Pull yourself up and toward one hand, bringing your chin beside it.
Pull up toward the other hand.
0747: Set an upright bench in the smith machine so the bar runs just behind your head.
Sit with your back against the pad and grip the bar wider than your shoulders.
Unrack the bar and lower it behind your neck.
Press it straight up until your arms are extended.
Lower slowly to the back of your neck and repeat.
0755: Set the Smith machine bar and safety stops to suitable heights.
With the bar latched, place it across your upper back and shoulders.
Take an overhand grip a little wider than shoulder width. Place your feet forward enough to stay balanced over both soles.
Release the hooks with your stance in place. Keep your chest up and trunk braced.
Bend at your knees and hips to lower your body within a range you can control.
Press through your feet to stand. Latch the bar again at the end of the set.
0758: Set an incline bench in the smith machine so the bar lines up with your upper chest.
Lie back and grip the bar underhand, palms facing you, about shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your upper chest, elbows close to your sides.
Press the bar up until your arms are straight.
0761: Set the smith bar at about knee height and stand close to it.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and grip the bar with your hands close together.
Unrack the bar and let your arms hang straight.
Row the bar to your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
0762: Set the smith bar at about knee height and stand close to it.
Hinge forward with a flat back and grip the bar wider than your shoulders.
Unrack the bar and let your arms hang straight.
Pull the bar toward your upper chest, leading with your elbows out to the sides.
Squeeze the backs of your shoulders, then lower slowly.
0764: Set a flat bench in the smith machine so the bar lines up with your lower chest.
Lie back and grip the bar underhand, palms facing you, about shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your lower chest, elbows close to your body.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
0769: Set the Smith bar at a height where you can reach it with your rear foot. Confirm that it is fully latched and cannot turn before using it for support.
Stand with your back to the bar and your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Reach the right foot backward and rest the top of that foot on the secured bar.
Bend your left knee and lower into the lunge with your trunk stable.
Press through the left heel to rise.
Step off before changing sides and set the left foot on the secured bar.
Repeat on each side for the planned repetitions.
0776: Stand over the bar with feet about hip-width apart. Bend at the hips and knees and take a wide snatch grip.
Push through the floor to lift the bar, keeping it near the shins and thighs.
As the bar approaches the hips, extend the legs and hips quickly and finish with a shrug.
Let the bar rise close to the body while staying tall and balanced.
Guide the bar back to the floor with control and set your position again for the next repetition.
0798: Set a moderate resistance and hold the handlebar.
Rise off the saddle and stand on the pedals with your body upright.
Pedal slowly, pushing each pedal down as if climbing stairs.
Keep your hips over the pedals and your core braced.
Keep a steady rhythm for the planned time, then sit down to cool off.
1015: Anchor a band at chest height and stand side-on to it, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band with both hands at the middle of your chest, with tension on it.
Brace your core and press your hands straight up overhead.
Hold briefly without letting your body turn toward the anchor.
Bring your hands back to your chest, finish the reps, then switch sides.
1290: Sit on a stability ball with a dumbbell, then walk your feet forward until your upper back rests on the ball.
Lift your hips so your body is level from knees to shoulders.
Hold the dumbbell beside your chest with your elbow bent.
Press it straight up until your arm is extended.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
1317: Set a bench to about 45 degrees and lie chest down on it, feet on the floor.
Grip the barbell below you underhand, palms facing forward, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
1325: Sit at the pulldown station with your thighs under the pads.
Grip the bar wide with an overhand grip, arms straight.
Tilt your head slightly forward and pull the bar down behind your head to the base of your neck.
Pause and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
1351: Stand on the platform with your feet hip-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Hinge forward with a flat back and grip the handles underhand.
Pull the handles toward your lower ribs, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
1374: Use a low, stable box with a clear landing area in front.
Stand on the box and step off the edge, allowing yourself to drop a short distance.
Land softly on both feet with the knees and hips slightly bent.
Once the landing is steady, transfer your weight to one leg and briefly hold your balance.
Step back onto the box and repeat, balancing on the other leg after landing.
1392: Sit in the leg press with your back against the pad.
Place the ball of one foot on the lower edge of the sled, heel hanging off, and keep the other foot off.
Release the stops with that knee straight but not locked.
Push the sled away by pointing your toes as far as you can.
Lower slowly for a full stretch, finish the reps, then switch legs.
1415: Sit on a bench and rest one forearm on your thigh, hand just past your knee.
Hold a dumbbell with a neutral grip, thumb on top.
Keep your forearm still and tilt the dumbbell up by bending at the wrist.
Lower it slowly as far as is comfortable.
Finish the reps, then switch hands.
1431: Set the assistance and stand on the platform.
Grip the close handles with your palms facing you, arms straight.
Pull yourself up, driving your elbows down to your sides.
Bring your chin above the handles.
1433: Set the Smith bar and safety stops for a front squat.
With the bar latched, step into position and rest it across the front of your shoulders.
Take the front squat grip with your elbows pointing forward and raised.
Place your feet in a balanced position, then release the hooks.
Brace your trunk and keep your chest raised.
Bend your hips and knees to lower your body.
Keep the bar supported by the front of your shoulders throughout the descent.
Press through both feet to stand and re-engage the hooks at the end.
1512: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Bend one knee and bring that heel toward your buttock, reaching back to hold the foot if you can keep your balance.
Ease into a gentle stretch at the front of the thigh while keeping your trunk steady.
Release the foot, return to the starting position, then switch sides.
1560: Sit tall on a stability ball with your feet flat on the floor.
Slide one foot forward and straighten that leg, heel on the floor and toes up.
Rest your hands on your bent knee and lean forward from the hips with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a stretch behind the straight thigh and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Sit back up and switch legs.
1621: Sit on a stability ball with a dumbbell, then walk your feet forward until your upper back rests on the ball.
Lift your hips so your body is level from knees to shoulders.
Hold the dumbbell at your chest with your palm facing in.
Press it straight up until your arm is extended, keeping the palm facing in.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
1628: Lie chest down on an incline bench with your feet on the floor.
Let your arms hang straight down and hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the bar up toward your face.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
1636: Set both pulleys high with a handle on each and stand in the middle.
Hold a handle in each hand, palms up, with your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the handles toward your head.
Straighten your arms slowly back out to the sides.
1643: Set both pulleys high with a handle on each and place a bench in the middle.
Sit tall and hold a handle in each hand, palms up, arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the handles toward your head.
Straighten your arms slowly back out to the sides.
1646: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms on the pad and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Keep one arm straight and curl the other dumbbell toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly to a straight arm.
Curl the other dumbbell the same way.
1649: Sit tall on a stability ball with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Straighten one leg and lift that foot off the floor.
Curl one dumbbell toward your shoulder, keeping the elbow at your side.
Lower it slowly while you curl the other.
Keep alternating arms; lift the other leg on the next set.
1667: Lie chest down on an incline bench with your feet on the floor.
Let one arm hang straight down holding a dumbbell with an overhand grip, and hold the bench with the other hand.
Keep your upper arm still and curl the dumbbell up.
Lower slowly to a straight arm, finish the reps, then switch arms.
1673: Kneel behind a stability ball and lean your chest against it.
Drape your upper arms over the ball with a dumbbell in each hand, palms up.
Keep your upper arms on the ball and curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
1675: Lie chest down on an incline bench with your feet on the floor.
Let your arms hang straight down with a dumbbell in each hand, overhand grip.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the dumbbells up.
1701: Place both hands close together on a stable medicine ball and extend your legs into a plank.
Keep your body aligned as you bend your elbows close to your sides and lower your chest toward the ball.
Press through both palms to return to the plank.
Repeat while you can keep the ball and your body steady.
1746: Sit on a stability ball with a dumbbell in each hand, then walk forward until your upper back rests on the ball.
Lift your hips level and press the dumbbells straight up, palms facing each other.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Straighten your arms to press them back up.
Keep your hips up for the whole set.
2209: Sit on the floor with a foam roller under the calf of one straight leg and the other foot flat.
Place your hands on the floor behind your hips, arms straight.
Press down through your hands, drawing your shoulders down and back, and lift your hips slightly.
Move your body forward and back so the roller travels along the calf.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch legs.
2327: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an underhand grip, palms facing forward.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees, arms hanging straight.
Row the dumbbells toward your hips, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
2334: Lie on your back on the machine with your head toward the stack end and your feet on the platform.
Move your feet down so only the balls of your feet are on its lower edge, heels hanging off.
Keep your knees almost straight and push the platform away by pointing your toes.
Lower slowly for a full calf stretch.
2736: Adjust the seat so your knees fit under the pads and sit down.
Grip the handles with your palms facing you, arms straight.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your back at the bottom.
Let the handles rise slowly until your arms are straight.
3011: Place your hands on a flat bench or another raised surface, shoulder-width apart, and walk your feet back into a straight-body plank.
Keep your elbows locked straight for the whole set.
Let your chest sink toward the bench as your shoulder blades squeeze together.
Push the bench away to spread your shoulder blades apart.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3012: Sit on a bench with your hands flat on it beside your hips and your arms straight.
Keep your elbows locked straight for the whole set.
Press your shoulders down, away from your ears, so your hips lift slightly off the bench.
Let your shoulders rise back toward your ears to lower your hips.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3021: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Keep your elbows locked straight for the whole set.
Let your chest sink between your shoulder blades as they squeeze together.
Push the floor away to spread your shoulder blades apart, rounding your upper back slightly.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3156: Stand facing a wall bar with your feet close to it.
Grip a rung at chest height with one hand.
Lean back until that arm is straight, body in a line from head to heels.
Pull your chest toward the bar, keeping your elbow close to your side.
Lower back slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
3162: Stand facing a wall bar with your feet near its base.
Hold a rung at chest height with one hand.
Lean back until your arm is straight and your body is in a line.
Row your chest toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blade.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
3195: Lie face down on the leg curl machine with the pad just above your heels and your knees just past the bench.
Hold the handles and keep your hips pressed down.
Curl the pad up toward your glutes with both legs.
Take one leg off the pad and lower the weight slowly with the other.
Curl up with both legs again and lower with the other leg next time.
3221: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms bent in front of your chest.
Lift one knee up to about hip height while the standing knee bends slightly.
Put the foot back down and lift the other knee the same way.
Keep alternating at a steady pace, chest up and core braced.
3237: Stand side-on to a landmine with your feet hip-width apart.
Hold the end of the bar in the hand nearer the anchor, arm straight by your hip.
Raise the bar out to the side and up until your arm points overhead, keeping it straight.
Lower it slowly back to your hip.
Finish the reps, then turn around and switch arms.
3281: Set the Smith bar and safety stops so you can squat within a controlled range.
Step under the latched bar and rest it across your upper back.
With the hooks still engaged, set your feet about shoulder-width apart with the toes slightly out.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders. Release the hooks once your stance is stable.
Brace your trunk and bend at the hips and knees.
Lower only as far as you can keep your feet planted and control the bar.
Press through both feet to stand, and latch the bar again at the end of the set.
3290: Hang from a bar with one hand and hold a light dumbbell in the other hand at your side.
Brace your core and pull your shoulder down.
Pull yourself up with the hanging arm until your chin reaches the bar.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
3295: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Lift your body into a front lever: straight and level with the floor, arms straight.
Keep your body level and pull the bar toward your hips by bending your elbows.
Lower slowly back to straight arms without dropping your hips.
Lower your legs to rest between sets.
3298: Place your hands on the floor or on parallettes, shoulder-width apart.
Lock your elbows and lean your shoulders forward past your hands.
Lift your feet off the floor and spread your legs wide.
Hold your body level with the floor, arms straight and core and glutes tight.
Hold for a few seconds, then lower your feet with control.
3641: Kneel tall on both knees, holding a weight plate with both hands in front of your hips.
Step one foot forward into a half-kneeling position.
At the same time, swing the plate up overhead with straight arms.
Lower the plate and bring the foot back to kneeling.
Finish your reps, then step with the other leg.
